$Comment: What each player who fought the Yeti sees when the fight is lost: everyone fell or left, and he waits
at full health for the next try. Its binding row points its Wiped beat here (Feedback.Wiped). The
second line is the lesson most first fights miss: step off the rings before the snowballs land, and
back off when the ring lights around him. A quiet Info toast, since the screen already went grey.
